description: Read a SnapGene .dna file: sequence, topology, every feature with its span, strand, display color and qualifiers (spliced and origin-spanning features kept as such), and the saved primer list.

featureLimit.description: Cap on features returned (max 2000). featureCount always reports the true total and `truncated` says whether the list was cut.

fileBase64.description: The binary SnapGene .dna file, base64-encoded. A `data:...;base64,` prefix is accepted.

includeSequence.description: Include the full sequence. Turn it off to ask what is IN a construct without moving the bases: a 250 kb BAC is 244 kB of the response and length/topology/features answer most questions without it.

name: parse_snapgene
title: SnapGene .dna Parser
